notes: The colophon is damaged. The syllables 'pātu ha' are the cataloguer's bracketed (uncertain or restored) reading, so the name Hariratna depends partly on that restoration. The 'pātu' part is probably a blessing formula, not part of the name. '.iṇḍa ..' after the name may be a title such as piṇḍapātika (a Buddhist monastic title) or part of a phrase, but it cannot be read safely. The scribe role comes from the damaged word 'likhit.' (probably likhitam). There is no date, place or commissioner.
